story_note: Isla visits the bookshop cafe corner on a Thursday morning, encountering a mid-week puzzle that feels trickier than expected, requiring her to slow down and reconsider her approach.
continuation_note: Unlike the previous calm, methodical sessions, today Isla faces a puzzle that resists her initial strategy, forcing her to backtrack slightly before finding the right thread to pull.
facebook_post_text: Thursday's puzzle had other ideas about how it wanted to be solved. https://suite.sapiverpress.co.uk

style_rules: Isla is the only active daily comic character.
Use ISLA_SP trigger word in every image prompt.
Young Black woman, warm medium brown skin, light freckles on nose and cheeks.
Natural coily dark hair in high voluminous puff bun.
Wide floral headband in teal, rust orange, cream, and dusty blue, worn across forehead.

Puzzle screen must come from a real captured puzzle page.
